provenance.lineage_summary: Derived from the retained Pleiades D0 geometry/current source and stabilized SciRel D2 successor behavior.
provenance.license_status: Source lineage and MIT license evidence are retained; human release approval remains pending.

scope: Ordered current projection and source lifecycle
Full retained BRB/WHAM configuration composition at finite targets
verification.evidence_ceiling: Named geometry, lifecycle and configuration cases only; no arbitrary-input scientific correctness or release claim.
known_limitations: No experimental validation of source device constants, conductor area proxy or material magnetization is claimed.
Direct geometry/weight arrays can be mutated; cache content changes are detected, but mutation that desynchronizes parameterized geometry from its parameters is outside the supported contract.
Unknown **kwargs are permissive where inherited; no arbitrary keyword semantic claim.
Plotting/patch, simplify/clone, multiprocessing, electrodes and persistent sweeps are excluded or unresolved.
All scientific, human and release approvals remain false.

summary: Finite signed filament approximation for an oriented rectangular magnet cross-section.

identity.direction: ring geometry and signed weights to filament response
identity.definition: Two radial faces with signed axial samples

outputs.name: source
outputs.description: Constructed MagnetRing object. Available properties/methods: rz_pts: Filament centers [m], (N,2); total_current: Weighted current [A], scalar
outputs.constraints: Properties expose generated coordinates; field methods require configured or supplied target mesh

preconditions: Inputs satisfy the documented finite cylindrical coordinate and shape contract

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Constructor or geometry setters raise ValueError for invalid supported inputs; unavailable source additions raise NotImplementedError. Source field methods reject a missing target mesh, nonfinite currents and active-filament coincidence.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Field evaluation propagates FloatingPointError on nonrepresentable kernel results. Failed parameterized geometry setters preserve the preceding valid state.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; direct geometry construction, transforms and static response.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial object is returned by a failed constructor. Atomic parameterized geometry setters preserve valid previous state.

example.code:
from scirel.electromagnetism import MagnetRing
r=MagnetRing()
assert r.npts == 16
example.expected: Signed filament geometry with default 16 samples.
